national_news.title: PM Inaugurates RBI Data Centre and Cybersecurity Institute in Odisha
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) new Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute at Info Valley-II in Jatni near Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
Constructed at an estimated cost of ₹170 crore, the data centre is designed to protect critical financial data and support mission-critical payment and settlement systems.
The integrated Cybersecurity Training Institute will focus on research and training in advanced domains, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), quantum computing, and enterprise computing.

national_news.title: SEBI Outlines Next Growth Phase and Regulatory Reforms for Capital Markets
bullets: Addressing the 16th ANMI International Capital Market Convention, SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey noted that India's equity market capitalization has reached ₹470 lakh crore, with Mutual Fund AUM at ₹83 lakh crore.
SEBI's investor education campaign 'Samajh Se Investing Simple' achieved over 15 crore social media views and sent nearly 110 crore messages to curb reliance on unregistered financial influencers.
Regulatory updates under development include reviewing short selling and securities lending/borrowing frameworks, boosting corporate bond secondary trading, and introducing an AI sandbox.

national_news.title: CRPF Disarms and Takes Over Kuki Militant Group's Sinai Camp in Manipur
bullets: Security forces led by the CRPF's CoBRA battalion disarmed and took control of the Sinai Camp in Manipur's Kangpokpi district, which was previously a designated camp for KNA and KLA under the Suspension of Operation (SoO) agreement.
The joint security operation was conducted following an ambush near the facility that resulted in the death of three civilians.
During the inspection, security teams identified 17 unauthorized individuals operating under false identities inside the SoO-designated camp.

national_news.title: India Calls for Diplomacy, Economic De-risking, and Human-Centric AI at Chinmaya Sammelan
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar addressed the Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan in New Delhi, emphasizing dialogue and diplomacy as the key solutions to ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and West Asia.
Highlighted the severe '4F crisis' (Finance, Fuel, Food, and Fertilizer) impacting the Global South, calling on the Global North to help de-risk and diversify international markets.
Advocated for a responsible, inclusive, and human-centric approach to Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ensure it remains democratized rather than controlled by a few.

national_news.title: India Slams Pakistan at UN Committee Over Minority Rights and 'Form 47' Administration
bullets: India's First Secretary to the UN, Raghoo Puri, exercised the right of reply during the UN General Assembly's Third Committee dialogue on minority issues.
Described Pakistan's government as a 'Form 47 administration' controlled by its military, highlighting the severe decline and oppression of minority communities in Pakistan.
Reaffirmed that the entire Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir is an integral part of India and called on Pakistan to vacate illegally occupied territories.

national_news.title: PM Highlights 'Vocal for Local' Exports, Organic Farming, and River Restoration
bullets: Highlighted global demand for Indian local products under 'Vocal for Local', including Makhana exports from Purnia (Bihar) to Greece and Shabari Naturals tribal products winning Japan's Good Design Award.
Commended the 'Nav-Trinjan' initiative by Punjab's Kheti Virasat Mission for promoting naturally colored organic cotton cultivation and establishing weaving schools.
Praised community-led ecological restoration in Tehri Garhwal, Uttarakhand, which successfully recharged groundwater and revitalized the Heval river.

national_news.title: Centre Achieves Target of Creating 11 Crore Farmer IDs Five Months Ahead of Deadline
bullets: The Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare created 11 crore unique Farmer IDs under the Digital Agriculture Mission, five months ahead of the March 2027 target.
The Digital Agriculture Mission was approved by the Union Cabinet on September 2, 2024, to build Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) for the agriculture sector.
Over 6 crore farmers have directly received scheme benefits through the verified Farmer ID delivery system, reducing fraud and redundant verification paperwork.

national_news.title: India Achieves Historic Best Performance with Record 114 Medals at Asian Para Games 2026
bullets: India's para-athlete contingent concluded the Asian Para Games 2026 with a historic best-ever total of 114 medals.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi lauded the contingent for their exceptional determination and record-breaking performance at the Games.
The achievement represents India's highest medal tally in the history of the Asian Para Games.

national_news.title: SEBI Chairman Highlights Retail Broking Growth and Investor Awareness at ANMI Convention
bullets: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated at the ANMI convention that the next wave of retail broking will originate from smaller towns and villages.
SEBI's 'Samajh Se Investing Simple' campaign has garnered over 15 crore views and 110 crore WhatsApp messages since October 5.
India's equity market capitalization stands at approximately 470 lakh crore rupees, with Mutual Fund AUM at around 83 lakh crore rupees.

national_news.title: EAM Dr S Jaishankar Emphasizes Dialogue, Diplomacy, and Multilateralism at Global Forum
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar stated at the Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan in New Delhi that dialogue and diplomacy are the only solutions to global conflicts like Ukraine and West Asia.
He highlighted that terrorism is a deadly threat to peace, noting that its use as an instrument of statecraft is unacceptable and requires zero tolerance from all states.

Addressing economic disparities, he noted that the Global South faces a 4F crisis (finance, fuel, food, and fertilizer) and advocated for an inclusive, human-centric approach to emerging technologies like AI.

national_news.title: India Exposes Pakistan's Minority Rights Violations and Military Control at UN
bullets: India strongly criticized Pakistan at the UN General Assembly’s Third Committee during an interactive dialogue with the Special Rapporteur on Minority Issues.
First Secretary to the UN Raghoo Puri called Pakistan's administration a 'Form 47 government' and highlighted that the country's military exercises decisive control over its political leadership.
India reiterated that Jammu and Kashmir is an integral part of the country and demanded the vacation of territories under Pakistan's illegal occupation.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi Marks 12 Years of Mann Ki Baat, Highlights Grassroots Initiatives
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the nation on Akashvani marking 12 years of the 'Mann Ki Baat' radio broadcast, which began on Vijayadashami.

He highlighted grassroots initiatives including Punjab's 'Kheti Virasat Mission' promoting organic cotton ('Nav-Trinjan'), the revitalization of the Heval river in Tehri Garhwal, and Maharashtra tribes' 'Shabari Naturals' winning Japan's Good Design Award.
The PM noted that 'Vocal for Local' is expanding global markets for Indian produce, citing Purnia's Makhana reaching Greece and Kalaburagi's Arhar Dal being exported to the Maldives.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Sets Rs 4.95 Lakh Crore Annual Credit Target for 2026-27
bullets: Bihar set an Annual Credit Plan target of Rs 4.95 lakh crore for the financial year 2026-27, focusing on agriculture, MSMEs, startups, and priority sectors.
The directives were issued during the third review meeting chaired by Development Commissioner Mihir Kumar Singh.
A new 100-point scientific measurement index was introduced to assess and rank the performance of banks operating in the state.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Develop Rs 16,500-Crore Manufacturing City in Gayaji
bullets: Bihar government unveiled the logo and portal for a 1,670-acre manufacturing city in Dobhi block of Gaya (Gayaji) under the Amritsar-Kolkata Industrial Corridor (AKIC).
The project carries an estimated investment potential of Rs 16,500 crore and aims to generate over 1.1 lakh jobs.
MoUs with 12 industrial units worth Rs 4,092 crore were signed across sectors like energy, textiles, automobiles, and agro-processing, and Bihar Business Connect 2027 was announced for February.

bihar_news.title: Piped Natural Gas (PNG) Service Launched in Buxar's Dumraon, Bihar
bullets: Piped Natural Gas (PNG) service has been inaugurated in the Textile Colony of Dumraon in Buxar district, Bihar, by District Magistrate Sahila Heer.
Implemented by Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL), a total of 498 technically feasible households have been provided with initial PNG connections.
The initiative eliminates the hassle of booking and transporting traditional LPG cylinders, offering an uninterrupted, cost-effective, and direct supply of cooking gas.
